commit_message: Reapply ADR0156 campaign core and UI on current main
pr_body:
## Summary

Reapplies the validated ADR 0156 campaign core and AI Studio campaign controls on current main after the ADR 0157 final-audit runtime changes landed. Preserves strict schema-v2 evidence identity, deterministic scheduling, persisted campaign state, exact preflight/resume behavior, aggregate reporting, and the manual evidence path while keeping runtime/visual tasks bound to the current production ADR 0157 surface.

Controlled fixture execution follows on this same Draft PR.
